profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer & Technical Leader | Founding Engineer - AI/ML - Platform Architecture - FedRAMP - Building Secure SaaS for Government
profile.summary: Principal Software Engineer with 20 years building high-scale systems.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical leader designing and building a multi-tenant SaaS platform for federal grant program verification. Responsible for technology vision, architecture, compliance, AI systems design, and engineering team leadership.

- Architected Spring Boot microservices with OAuth2/OIDC authorization, full observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Grafana), and CI/CD to AWS EKS
- Designed AI pipeline: document extraction, classification with evaluation framework
- Leading FedRAMP Moderate certification with compliance controls mapped across FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001 (AI governance)
- Authored architecture decision records defining domain model, data architecture, security, and AI strategy
